answer: Honest-anchored triangle counting resists sybils: a vertex earns standing from closed trust triangles in which at least two members are already-honest agents, not from raw edge count. A sybil ring can weave a dense sonnet of mutual links among its own fakes, but those triangles contain no honest members and score zero. Bridging into the real set needs genuine honest co-vouchers that fakes cannot fabricate, so standing stays glacier-frozen however many identities interlink. Precondition: a trusted honest seed set anchors the count.
